We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Hi, we looked at the data you sent and we can go with the 1500 ppm target from Option A. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
